name: Mateo Vargas
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the vibrant liveries of race cars. Growing up in Lima, he spent hours sketching designs and experimenting with paint techniques on model cars. After completing a vocational course in automotive painting, he sought opportunities in local workshops before finally landing a role with a smaller racing team. His meticulous attention to detail and knack for matching colors quickly earned him recognition. Mateo is passionate about creating visually stunning designs that not only enhance the aesthetic appeal of the cars but also contribute to the team's overall brand identity. He believes a flawless paint job is more than just cosmetic; it's a statement of pride and professionalism.

At CLRT by Almeras, Mateo thrives on the challenge of working with high-performance machinery. He is constantly seeking new ways to improve the durability and finish of the paint, exploring innovative techniques like ceramic coatings and airbrushing to achieve unparalleled results. Mateo's collaborative spirit makes him an invaluable asset to the team, as he readily shares his knowledge and expertise with his colleagues. Outside the workshop, he enjoys attending local car shows and customizing his own vintage motorcycle.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a wiry build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears a pristine white lab coat, even when doing the dirtiest jobs.
Has a collection of miniature car models displayed on his workbench, each with a unique paint scheme.
Listens to traditional Peruvian music while working to stay focused.
